description.fun: One of the biggest Pokémon ever discovered, strong enough to stir up great waves, and a glutton who is terrible at actually catching food. So it teams up with a Tatsugiri, treats the little fish as its boss, follows its orders loyally and lets it live in its mouth for safety. With its headband and tongue like a sushi board, it looks a lot like a sushi chef.
description.guide: A huge Water-type catfish Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, designed by James Turner. It hunts in partnership with Tatsugiri, which lives in its mouth and commands it. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A giant catfish taking orders from a tiny boss
